sentences.cn_text: 科学出版长期以来一直是一种印钞许可证。
sentences.en_text: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.

sentences.cn_text: 科学家需要期刊来发表研究成果，因此他们会无偿提供文章。
sentences.en_text: Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.

sentences.cn_text: 其他科学家也免费进行同行评审这一专业工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心环节。
sentences.en_text: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.

sentences.cn_text: 由于论文内容可免费获取，出版商只需为其期刊寻找市场。
sentences.en_text: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only to find a market for its journal.

sentences.cn_text: 直到本世纪，大学图书馆对价格都不太敏感。
sentences.en_text: Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.

sentences.cn_text: 科学出版商常规性地报告其运营利润率接近40%，而此时出版业的其他领域正处于生存危机之中。
sentences.en_text: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations, at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.

sentences.cn_text: 荷兰巨头爱思唯尔声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年盈利超过9亿英镑，而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，使研究人员能够访问他们自己由公共资金资助的研究成果；尽管各方越来越迫切地试图改变这种状况,这两个数字似乎仍在不可阻挡地上升。
sentences.en_text: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.

sentences.cn_text: 最激烈且完全非法的反应是Sci-Hub的出现，这是一个全球性的科学论文复制平台，成立于2012年，目前声称可以提供自2015年以来发表的所有付费墙文章的访问权限。
sentences.en_text: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of SciHub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.

sentences.cn_text: Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的论文副本，这表明现有法律生态系统在其用户中已失去合法性，必须进行变革以使其服务于所有参与者。
sentences.en_text: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.

sentences.cn_text: 在英国，向开放获取出版转型的举措是由资助机构推动的。
sentences.en_text: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies.

sentences.cn_text: 在某些方面它取得了很大成功。
sentences.en_text: In some ways it has been very successful.

sentences.cn_text: 目前超过半数的英国科学研究是以开放获取条款发表的：要么从发表之时起即可免费获取，要么设置一年或更长时间的付费墙，以便出版商在公开发布前获取利润。
sentences.en_text: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，新系统对大学而言并未降低成本。
sentences.en_text: Yet the new system has not worked out any cheaper for the universities.

sentences.cn_text: 出版商通过向作者收取费用以支付文章准备成本，来回应让其产品对读者免费的要求。
sentences.en_text: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.

sentences.cn_text: 这些费用从约500英镑到5000美元不等。
sentences.en_text: These range from around £500 to $5,000.

sentences.cn_text: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费用和这些「文章准备费用」都在以高于通货膨胀率的速度稳步上涨。
sentences.en_text: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these “article preparation costs” had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.

sentences.cn_text: 在某些方面,科学出版模式类似于社交互联网经济：劳动免费提供以换取获得地位的希望，而巨额利润则由少数几家经营市场平台的大型公司获取。
sentences.en_text: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.

sentences.cn_text: 在这两种情况下，我们都需要权力的重新平衡。
sentences.en_text: In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.

sentences.cn_text: 科学出版被视为「印钞许可证」，部分原因是____
sentences.en_text: Scientific publishing is seen as “a licence to print money” partly because ____

sentences.cn_text: 其资金获得了稳定增长。
sentences.en_text: its funding has enjoyed a steady increase.

sentences.cn_text: 其营销策略非常成功。
sentences.en_text: its marketing strategy has been successful.

sentences.cn_text: 其对同行评审的支付减少了。
sentences.en_text: its payment for peer review is reduced.

sentences.cn_text: 其内容获取不需成本。
sentences.en_text: its content acquisition costs nothing.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第2段和第3段，像爱思唯尔这样的科学出版商____
sentences.en_text: According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers like Elsevier have ____

sentences.cn_text: 主要依靠大学图书馆而兴旺发展。
sentences.en_text: thrived mainly on university libraries.

sentences.cn_text: 经历了生存危机。
sentences.en_text: gone through an existential crisis.

sentences.cn_text: 使出版业重获生机。
sentences.en_text: revived the publishing industry.

sentences.cn_text: 慷慨地资助了研究人员。
sentences.en_text: financed researchers generously.

sentences.cn_text: 作者对Sci-Hub的成功持何态度？
sentences.en_text: How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub?

sentences.cn_text: 感到宽慰。
sentences.en_text: Relieved.

sentences.cn_text: 感到困惑。
sentences.en_text: Puzzled.

sentences.cn_text: 感到担忧。
sentences.en_text: Concerned.

sentences.cn_text: 受到鼓舞。
sentences.en_text: Encouraged.

sentences.cn_text: 从第5段和第6段可以得知，开放获取条款____
sentences.en_text: It can be learned from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that open access terms ____

sentences.cn_text: 给出版商留出了一定的盈利空间。
sentences.en_text: allow publishers some room to make money.

sentences.cn_text: 使科学家发表论文更加容易。
sentences.en_text: render publishing much easier for scientists.

sentences.cn_text: 大幅降低了出版成本。
sentences.en_text: reduce the cost of publication substantially.

sentences.cn_text: 使大学摆脱了财政负担。
sentences.en_text: free universities from financial burdens.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项是科学出版模式的特征？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following characterises the scientific publishing model?

sentences.cn_text: 提供试用订阅。
sentences.en_text: Trial subscription is offered.

sentences.cn_text: 劳动胜过地位。
sentences.en_text: Labour triumphs over status.

sentences.cn_text: 成本得到了良好控制。
sentences.en_text: Costs are well controlled.

sentences.cn_text: 少数人靠多数人获利。
sentences.en_text: The few feed on the many.
